attribution: Reconstruction of the supplied manuscript's qualitative block/slicing argument with a proposed explicit support constant; not a new independently certified theorem.
decisive_argument: Common preceding perturbed hearts give X<=1000000*N and N<=2Q/5. Coordinate recovery bounds the pulled-back l1 norm by 4500004*Q/5, and max_m norm_1(M^m)=82/3 gives the claimed constant. A positive sector projection plus the full lattice yields finite HN refinements and strict finite length.
supported_scope: Support constant 30000000 for coordinate l1 and Euclidean norms and all same-phase extensions.
Finite actual block filtrations, saturated and unsaturated semistability tests and Hom vanishing.
Both endpoint conventions, summand closure, and locally finite quasi-abelian intervals of width less than one.
limitations: Numerical lattice identification and the actual category are not formalized by the algebraic source.
